Also tried a chicken shish tawook sandwich which was delicious. It is like a halal cart platter wrapped in a pita. Also available on a long roll.

review_text:
Misconduct - the name is bad, but it is a great spot!  This is the go-to place to watch any game.  There are lots of TV's, and always a decent view from wherever you're sitting, even outside!  They set up a small outdoor seating area with a TV!  It's a very friendly atmosphere, and even when it's crowded you can still stand or sit at the bar and see with all those TV's in there.  Lots of fun.

Inside it's kinda charmingly cheesy with the nautical theme, but I like it.  The food is so-so, but the scene is really about going to watch a game and have drinks.  The fries were yummy with chipotle mayo, but over-salted.  I had a special salad with duck, citrus over spring mix...eh.  I know, why would I get duck...at Misconduct Tavern?  It was a little bland and there was way too much fennel seed sprinkled on top.

My friend got the mac n cheese with tomato...which looked dee-lish.

Half a very small chicken and two sides at Rustica is $22.00 bucks!!!! Rotisserie chickens are $4.00 dollars at any supermarket!!!

LaLo was $14.00 bucks for 3 mini egg rolls, 2 tiny chicken skewers and a cup of rice. Have they seen what you can get for $8.00 in Chinatown, which is 2 blocks away?

Overpriced and small portions are a no go for me. Maybe they can succeed tricking tourists, but I've left starving every time.

The service was great, our server was attentive and gave good recommendations on the amount of food to order.

We ordered the fried catfish platter with Mac n cheese and collard greens and the fried chicken (leg and thigh) with Mac n cheese and string beans along with an extra side of rice and gravy. Pluses: not greasy, generous portions, varied menu. Minuses: lacked authenticity in flavors, veggies had no seasoning, rice was the same white rice used for Chinese food take out; instead of pleasantly marrying with the gravy, it just soaked it all up and was gummy. The catfish had a nice, light batter but not what I was expecting for soul food and the chicken was tender with a nice crispy coating but it wasn't a stand-out.

We both ordered the mustard soup with scallop as our appetizers.  This was my favorite of the evening.  The scallop was perfectly cooked, large, and tender.
